results.content: Many of the issues that drove the decision to leave the European Union—immigration, government spending, low and uneven economic growth—remain salient and bitterly contested within and between the major political parties in the United Kingdom today. Keir Starmer, the outgoing Labour prime minister who took his party to a thumping victory over the Tories in 2024, was plagued by scandals in his party, perceptions of aloofness and ineffectiveness, controversial budget-cutting decisions and a [...] A big part of the answer to your question resides in the Conservative Party. Five of the seven prime ministers were Tories, and all of these changes at the top occurred between 2016 and 2024, a period of continuous Tory rule. The constant changing of the prime ministerial guard among Conservatives can be traced back to deep divides within the party, which meant that sitting Tory PMs had a difficult and ultimately impossible time holding together stable parliamentary majorities. And a big part [...] On Monday, July 20, 2026, Andy Burnham became the new prime minister of the United Kingdom. He took over the government from Keir Starmer as the seventh prime minister in the decade since the June 2016 Brexit vote. What factors have led the UK to have such turbulence in the political system, and is the former mayor of Manchester likely to steady the ship? Press Association via AP Images [...] LONDON — Change — the single word written on every Labour Party general election campaign flier, poster and leaflet. And the British electorate delivered, ushering in a seismic change.

But despite voters handing the new U.K. prime minister, Keir Starmer, a landslide victory, there was no stampede of support for him and his outfit.
